description:
Make the four lock tests that skip when a read-only file is writable establish that precondition on every host, or fail, instead of passing.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/storage/lock.rs` defines `skip_unless_write_is_denied` (`:652`). Four tests call it (`:676`, `:729`, `:773`, `:805`), among them `test_lock_shared_is_granted_when_the_lock_file_cannot_be_opened_for_writing`. When the process can still write a file whose mode denies writing, as root can, the helper prints "skipping …" and the test returns early and passes. `@/inv/no-ignored-tests` treats a test held out of the run as a property nobody checks.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `skip_unless_write_is_denied` no longer exists, and none of the four tests returns early because of the host.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each test establishes a lock path that the process cannot open for writing on every host, for example a path whose parent is not a directory or a read-only bind it creates itself, or fails naming the precondition it could not establish.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Read-only lock tests establish their precondition on any host
